label: Effect of photobiomodulation on pain and quality of life in fibromyalgia syndrome: a systematic review.
summary: Fibromyalgia Syndrome (FMS) is a chronic pain disorder characterized by widespread pain and central sensitization that significantly impacts the quality of life (QoL). For management to be effective, a multidisciplinary approach to care is typically required. Photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT), a non-pharmacological treatment, has garnered attention lately, though its clinical relevance and applications are not well defined.
